approved_payload.content: Police say three unknown gunmen kicked open the door of a two-room flat at Willowvale Extension 1 informal settlement, near Ematyotyombeni, at about 21:50 on Tuesday 6 October and opened fire. Five young men aged 17 to 22 died, four in the flat and one on arrival at a clinic, and a man of 30 was wounded (SAPS, Brig Nobuntu Gantana). Numerous 9mm cartridges and projectiles were found. Police say the motive is unknown; no arrests reported in the sources read. The Daily Dispatch visited on 8 October: some residents said they believed it was linked to a fight over drug territory, which police have not said. Mbhashe Local Municipality condemned the killings. The victims were not named.
